hook.say: Europe edition! You have seen this map a thousand times. So which country is bigger? Five duels, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is bigger: Spain or Germany?
questions.fact: Spain is about 40% bigger than Germany.
questions.sayAnswer: Spain! It is about forty percent bigger than Germany.

questions.q: Which is bigger: UK or Italy?
questions.say: Which is bigger: the U K or Italy?
questions.fact: Italy is almost a quarter bigger than the United Kingdom.
questions.sayAnswer: Italy! It is almost a quarter bigger than the United Kingdom.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Germany or Sweden?
questions.fact: Sweden is a quarter bigger than Germany, with an eighth of the people.
questions.sayAnswer: Sweden! It is a quarter bigger than Germany, with about an eighth of the people.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Germany or Finland?
questions.fact: Germany wins, but only by about 6%. Finland is huge.
questions.sayAnswer: Germany! But only by about six percent. Finland is huge.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Portugal or Iceland?
questions.fact: Iceland is about 12% bigger than Portugal, with about 400,000 people.
questions.sayAnswer: Iceland! It is about twelve percent bigger than Portugal, with only about four hundred thousand people.
